best_idea: Make each skill a row of six ability weights that sum to 1, so trickle = floor(weighted ability sum / 4), recomputed live from the abilities on every read; build choices become data rows.
decision_why: The weighted ability-to-skill row and the live recomputation fit a server-verified skill value and turn build differences into catalogue rows. Adapt: enforce sum-to-1 in a test, drop the unread dependency lists, and fix the profession-13 cost lookup.
acceptance: A server test asserts every skill row sums to 1 (it fails on the donor row 135) and that a 40-point strength rise on a skill with strength weight 0.2 adds exactly 2 to that skill's trickle.
